Nora: Quick heads-up  CardioLabs QBR next Tue. Finance asked for a one-slide spend forecast, onboarding blockers, and renewal posture.
Kai: I'll run 45d history + 2-week burn scenarios. Noticed heavy daytime jobs hitting /embeddings every 30m since launch.
Isha: Snapshot: current billing period tokens = 98.3M, avg daily = 3.3M, recent pilot uplift ~+46% over baseline for 6d.
Diego: If that trajectory holds they cross their soft guard in ~9 days. Options: short-term cushion (commit buffer), temporary burst credits, or per-route caps.
FinOps-Bot: alert: CardioLabs retainer at 71% of committed; projection crosses commit in 9 days under sustained spike.
Nora: Renewal risk? Product adoption positive but finance flags unpredictability.
Isha: Risk = medium. We should lead with operational fixes + a small commercial ask framed as predictability.
Kai: Proposed QBR bullets: runway (tokens left + days), 3 scenarios (baseline, sustained, de-escalation), recommended ask (10% commit cushion OR 30-day top-up), enablement plan (prompt tuning + scheduling).
Nora: Suggested ask wording: "Recommend a 10% retainer cushion for next quarter to cover pilot bursts, plus a short enablement session to optimize embeddings." Keep CFO-friendly.
Diego: I provisioned emergency burst credits: `60k credits | expires 12d` and left an account note. Also drafted an SE checklist: 1) enable prefix caching, 2) move large batches to off-peak, 3) lower embed dims if acceptable.
Isha: Can we add a tiny feedback poll in the QBR: 1) "Would you trade a small latency uplift for predictable lower cost?" 2) "Is a 30-45m enablement session valuable?"
Kai: Good. Also need per-route P95 latency + tokens for last 14d to build a cost-vs-latency scatter slide.
Nora: I'll export traces and token distribution from Console and drop CSV by Thu EOD.
Diego: Recommend adding a short "cost thermostat" policy: auto-topup at 85% retainer (one-time temporary credit) + 48h notify, with rollback if usage normalizes. Want me to draft policy blurb?
Isha: Yes please — include exact triggers and expiration for the top-up. Finance will want clear guardrails.
FinOps-Bot: note: invoices and commit history available at /billing/cardio/2026-03.
Nora: Action items recap:
- Kai: deck + scenarios + cost/latency slide (due Fri EOD)
- Isha: renewal blurb + two feedback q's (post here)
- Diego: confirm credits & policy draft + SE checklist
- Nora: export P95 & token CSV; schedule QBR and invite finance lead
Kai: I'll post draft slides here for review.
Isha: Posting feedback q's shortly.
Nora: Using this thread as the canonical QBR ops thread for CardioLabs. Ping if anything shifts. :white_check_mark:
